name: beiyemd
description: A lightweight local Markdown reader and editor for quick viewing and easy changes
author: BeiyeMD contributors

scripts.dist: npm run legal:notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run legal:notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run legal:notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run legal:notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run legal:notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run legal:notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
